Figure 3:Overview ofStreamingSwap.
Phase I restricts video processing to face-RoI tokens and balances latent reconstruction with identity supervision through noise-dependent weighting.
Phase II fine-tunes the model through self-rollout with short generated histories, enabling streaming inference while retaining bidirectional generation within each chunk.

Figure 4:Qualitative comparison on short and long videos.
Higher identity similarity can coexist with reduced target fidelity and realism, whereasStreamingSwapbalances them.

Figure 5:Qualitative ablation ofStreamingSwap.
Top: identity supervision strengthens source-identity transfer, while Face-RoI preserves visual quality.
Bottom: self-rollout aligns training with streaming inference, mitigating error accumulation and progressive visual degradation.
